title: Grateful Dead Live at The Scope on 1982-04-03
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) >KORG AudioGate 4 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a blistering 1982 show with scorching Scarlet > Fire and a tight Eyes of the World.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised for its nonstop groove, high‑energy second set and memorable transitions—especially the legendary Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain run and a compact yet packed Eyes of the World. Reviewers also note that the CM‑transferred soundboard source sounds crystal‑clear and “off the charts,” making the performance highly listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are 5‑star, highlighting a top‑tier musical performance and an excellent soundboard recording with no noted flaws.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call the CM transfer crisp and "off the charts," indicating a clean, well‑balanced mix with no apparent issues.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first set leading into an incendiary second set; transitions (e.g., Scarlet > Fire) are highlighted as tantalizing, keeping the momentum high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Mentioned in context of a possible Phil/Jerry switch night and noted that the whole band was "firing on all cylinders," implying strong lead guitar work.
band_member_comments.Phil: Alluded to with the "Phil/Jerry switch" comment, indicating his bass was a key part of the groove.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir fans are specifically delighted; his rhythm/vocal contributions helped keep the band in the pocket.
